members: public BroadcastService(ValidatedEventConsumer buffer, TelemetryEventSource source, TelemetryMetrics metrics, int sinkCapacity) { this.buffer = buffer; this.source = source; this.metrics = metrics; this.sink = Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(sinkCapacity, false); }
public void stop() { if (subscription != null) { subscription.dispose(); } }

private void emit(TelemetryWindowBroadcast window) { Sinks.EmitResult result = sink.tryEmitNext(window); if (result == Sinks.EmitResult.FAIL_OVERFLOW) { metrics.broadcastDropped("subscriber-overflow"); LOG.warn("broadcast-overflow-dropped"); } else if (result.isSuccess()) { metrics.windowBroadcast("broadcast"); LOG.info("window-broadcast"); } }
